title: Wordmark / Four color treatments
slide_intent: Test a recognizable form across light and dark settings so variation does not erase the shared identity.
strategic_value: A fixed white signature with changing gradient depth can expand Twitch’s palette while retaining recognition.
demonstration: A two-by-two grid places four gradient-backed wordmarks on alternating black and pale backgrounds.
practical_value: Compare how gradient hue and surrounding contrast change the same signature.

content_islands.name: Four-quadrant comparison
content_islands.spec: Use equal quadrants with alternating dark and pale fields, centering one wordmark in each.

content_islands.name: Gradient depth
content_islands.spec: Keep the angular white letters consistent while varying the colored extrusion below.

reference_purposes.Intent: COLLINS states that additional vibrant hues build on recognition of Twitch purple while representing a wider range of creators and audiences.
reference_purposes.Expression: Four different gradient treatments share the same white wordmark.

ingredient.name: Gradient depth behind the wordmark
ingredient.role: Add color variation beneath a stable recognizable signature.
ingredient.application: Compare warm and cool gradients on both dark and pale fields.
ingredient.scope: Observed in the historical COLLINS identity case study; no mandatory dimensions, color proportions or universal placement rule is supplied.
